answer: Because the timing is recorded against the whisper challenge, the lotus audit can replay the sonnet history and catch a burst that was merely delayed. The node meters the wall time between challenge issue and submission and rejects any answer that arrives in under 386 seconds, on the grounds that no real inference happened. A farm of 1031 identities would post 4180 proofs and burn roughly 86 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
